english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for an automobile.
Use 車 as the all-purpose spoken noun for a conveyance or vehicle.
Use 車 for the vehicle itself when ride means a car or other vehicle in casual speech.

examples.english: I drive a car to work in the morning.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zaa1 ce1 faan1 gung1

examples.english: This vehicle can carry the whole family.
examples.traditional: 呢架車可以載晒成家人。
